received.b:
Hi {first},

Thank you for applying to the {programme}. Your application reference is {ref}.

Your next step is a 5-minute readiness assessment on basic digital skills and communication. You can take it now or any time in the next 3 days.

passed.s: You passed! Book your Discovery Call
passed.b:
Hi {first},

Well done: you scored {score}% on the readiness assessment.

Next, book a 15-minute Discovery Call with Admissions. We'll talk about what you want to do and agree the track that fits you.

failed.b:
Hi {first},

Thank you for taking the readiness assessment. You scored {score}%, and the pass mark is {pass}%, so we can't move your application forward this time.

You're welcome to apply again for the next batch. Meanwhile, you can join the Jobnest Community waitlist on jobnestcareers.com. It opens soon, with resources and people building careers like you.

times.s: New Discovery Call times are available
times.b:
Hi {first},

Admissions has opened new times for Discovery Call 1. Pick the one that suits you; it takes 15 minutes.

booked.s: Your Discovery Call is booked: {date}, {time} WAT
booked.b:
Hi {first},

Your 15-minute Discovery Call with {manager} is booked for {longdate} at {time} WAT.

The video link will be sent 30 minutes before the call. Come ready to talk about what you enjoy and what you want to do. This is where we agree your track together.

callthanks.b:
Hi {first},

Thank you for the call. You agreed on the {track} track.

Admissions is now reviewing your application. You'll hear from us within 3 working days.

notrack.s: Thank you for your Discovery Call
notrack.b:
Hi {first},

Thank you for your time on the call. You're interested in {interest}, and the {programme} doesn't offer that track yet.

This isn't a judgement of you. We've noted your interest and will invite you first if we launch it. No payment was taken.

Meanwhile, you can join the Jobnest Community waitlist on jobnestcareers.com. It opens soon, with resources and people building careers like you.

offer.b:
Hi {first},

Congratulations! You've been offered a place on the {track} track of the {programme}, {cohort}.

To accept, pay in full or the first of 2 instalments by {deadline}. After that the seat goes to the waitlist.

waitlist_full.b:
Hi {first},

The {track} track is full right now, so you're on the waitlist. If a seat opens, we'll email you an offer straight away.

waitlist.b:
Hi {first},

Thank you for your patience. You're on the waitlist for the {track} track, and we'll email you if a seat opens.

notselected.b:
Hi {first},

Thank you for applying. We're not able to offer you a place this time.

You're welcome to apply for the next batch.

deferred.s: Your application has moved to the next batch
deferred.b:
Hi {first},

Your application has been moved to batch {batch}. We'll contact you when admissions for that batch open.

reminder.b:
Hi {first},

Just a reminder that your offer for the {track} track expires on {deadline}.

You can pay in full or in 2 instalments, and discount codes are applied at payment.

expired.b:
Hi {first},

Your offer for the {track} track has expired because payment wasn't made by {deadline}, so the seat has gone to someone on the waitlist.

If you'd still like a place, reply to this email and Admissions will let you know your options.

declined.b:
Hi {first},

We've recorded that you declined your offer. Your seat will go to someone on the waitlist.

If your plans change, you're welcome to apply for the next batch.

admitted.s: Welcome to Jobnest Academy! Your matric number is {matric}
admitted.b:
Hi {first},

Payment received: {amount}. You are now admitted into the {track} track of the {programme}, {cohort}.

Your matric number is {matric}. Use the button below to set your password, then sign in to the student portal with your matric number and that password.

invite.s: Good news: a {interest} track is opening
invite.b:
Hi {first},

When we spoke, you told us you're interested in {interest}. Jobnest Academy is opening a {interest} track, and you're one of the first people we're inviting.

Your Zuri summary and call notes are saved, so applying takes about 5 minutes.

apps_open.b:
Hi {first},

You asked us to tell you when applications open. They're open now.

Start with a short chat with Zuri if you're not sure what you want to do yet, then apply in about 5 minutes.

letter_admit.b:
Congratulations! You are now admitted into the {track} track of the Jobnest Academy {programme}, {cohort}.

We can't wait to see you build a career you're proud of.

letter_offer.s: Congratulations, {first}! You've been offered a place.
